name: agent-hub
description: Agent Hub: a live Claude Code pane for context fill, the task checklist, subagents, background shells and 5h/7d usage limits, with remote control from a phone

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: When a subagent may be stuck or the context window passes 80%: toast shows a toast in Claude Code; notify also sends a notification through your terminal's notification channel; off says nothing (the pane still shows it).
